edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, tying privileges to the untrusted caller.
Constructor parameter _controller is written into the controller state variable.
Constructor parameter _vault is written into the immutable vault variable.
Constructor parameter _underlying is written into the immutable underlying variable.
setAdmin writes the _admin parameter into admin.
setController writes the _controller parameter into controller.
setPerformanceFee writes the _fee parameter into performanceFee.
setSlippage writes the _slippage parameter into slippage.
setDelta writes the _delta parameter into delta.
setForceExit writes the _forceExit parameter into forceExit.
PERFORMANCE_FEE_CAP bounds the fee accepted by setPerformanceFee.
SLIPPAGE_MAX bounds the slippage accepted by setSlippage.
DELTA_MIN lower-bounds the delta accepted by setDelta.
onlyAdmin gate compares msg.sender with admin before executing setAdmin.
onlyAdmin gate protects setController.
onlyAdmin gate protects setPerformanceFee.
onlyAdmin gate protects setSlippage.
onlyAdmin gate protects setDelta.
onlyAdmin gate protects setForceExit.

onlyAuthorized gate restricts withdraw.
onlyAuthorized gate restricts withdrawAll.
onlyAuthorized gate restricts skim.
onlyAuthorized gate restricts harvest.
onlyAuthorized gate restricts exit.
onlyAdmin gate restricts sweep.
Expected underlying amount flows into _increaseDebt.
Deposit amount parameter flows into deposit.
Withdraw amount parameter flows into withdraw before the total-assets check.
The immutable underlying token is used for the transferFrom call.
Vault is the source address of the underlying pull.
Requested amount is the value moved by safeTransferFrom.
_increaseDebt invokes safeTransferFrom on the underlying token.
balBefore participates in computing the debt increase.
balAfter participates in computing the debt increase.
_increaseDebt increases totalDebt by the measured balance delta.
Underlying token is transferred back to the vault.
Vault is the destination of the decrease-debt transfer.
_decreaseDebt performs the external underlying transfer.
Measured diff feeds the raw totalDebt subtraction in _decreaseDebt.
Unchecked subtraction updates totalDebt.
_decreaseDebt executes the raw subtraction path.
deposit calls _increaseDebt before investing.
deposit calls the protocol-specific _deposit hook.
withdraw caches _totalAssets into totalUnderlying.
withdraw reads total underlying through _totalAssets.
totalUnderlying is passed to _getShares as denominator.
_getShares returns the share amount used for withdrawal.
totalUnderlying participates in the share computation.
withdraw calls _withdraw(shares) when shares > 0.
withdraw measures the strategy underlying balance after unwinding.
underlyingBal is passed to _decreaseDebt for transfer to the vault.
withdrawAll delegates to _withdrawAll.
_withdrawAll queries _getTotalShares.
_withdrawAll calls _withdraw(totalShares).
_withdrawAll decreases debt and resets totalDebt to zero.
totalAssets delegates to the overridable _totalAssets.
skim reads _totalAssets to compute profit.
profit is produced by the raw totalUnderlying - totalDebt subtraction.
totalDebt is the subtrahend of the raw subtraction in skim.
delta multiplier is used to compute the max bound.
DELTA_MIN is the denominator of the max bound.
The max bound decides whether skim increases debt or withdraws profit.
profit is added directly to totalDebt when within bounds.
skim calls _getShares for the profit amount above the bound.
skim calls _withdraw(shares) to realise profit.
Underlying token is used for the profit transfer in skim.
Vault is the recipient of the skimmed profit.
skim performs an external token transfer before its accounting settles.

fee is the amount transferred to treasury.
performanceFee is used to compute the fee amount.

Remaining token balance is re-deposited into Curve.
Uniswap swap is an external call executed inside harvest before accounting is finalised, enabling callback reentrancy.
Curve add_liquidity is an external call inside the harvest deposit path.
ERC20 transfer to treasury can invoke a malicious token callback re-entering harvest.
Minter.mint is an external call executed before balances are used in _claimRewards.
ERC20 transfer to the vault inside skim can re-enter before debt accounting settles.
ERC20 transfer to the vault inside _decreaseDebt can re-enter the withdraw flow.
safeTransferFrom pulls tokens from the vault and a malicious token can re-enter deposit.
exit claims rewards converted to the underlying token.
exit withdraws everything back to the vault.
forceExit short-circuits authorised exit and leaves funds in the strategy.
